module mg_09642(input clk,output SRAM_CE, SRAM_OE, SRAM_WE, SRAM_UB, SRAM_LB,output [17:0] SRAM_A,inout [15:0] SRAM_D,input [0:3] nb_,input [0:15] ad_,output [0:15] ddt_,input [0:15] rdt_,input w_, r_, s_,output ok_);
assign SRAM_CE = 0; 
  assign SRAM_UB = 0; 
  assign SRAM_LB = 0; 
  assign SRAM_WE = ~we; 
  assign SRAM_OE = ~oe; 
  assign ok_ = ~(ok & (~r_ | ~w_)); 
  `define IDLE 0 
  `define READ 1 
  `define WRITE 2 
  `define OK 3 
  reg [1:0] state = `IDLE; 
  reg we, oe, ok; 
  reg [0:15] rd_data; 
  always @ (posedge clk) begin 
  case (state) 
  `IDLE: begin 
  if (~r_) begin 
  state <= `READ; 
  oe <= 1; 
  end else if (~w_) begin 
  state <= `WRITE; 
  we <= 1; 
  end 
  end 
  `READ: begin 
  rd_data <= SRAM_D; 
  ok <= 1; 
  state <= `OK; 
  end 
  `WRITE: begin 
  we <= 0; 
  ok <= 1; 
  state <= `OK; 
  end 
  `OK: begin 
  oe <= 0; 
  if (r_ & w_) begin 
  ok <= 0; 
  state <= `IDLE; 
  end 
  end 
  endcase 
  end 
  assign SRAM_A[17:0] = {2'b00, ~ad_}; 
  assign SRAM_D = we ? ~rdt_ : 16'hzzzz; 
  assign ddt_ = ~r_ ? ~rd_data : 16'hffff; 
 endmodule
